s.v: • 🌐 **Website login**: log in with Discord on the website to see your player card, buy from the shop and change your name with a Rename Card. Everything you do there takes effect on Discord too.
• ❤️ Likes: tap the **Like** button on /profile to like a player. The Likes count shows under the Last Match.

• 🪪 **Rename Card** is now in the /shop for 37,450 ChuPoints - pick a Game Name that stays the same on every server.
• 🧾 **Item Tax** - a tax can now be added on every item bought with ChuPoints. Changes are posted in /news.

• Your Game Name is shown in every match and on every leaderboard, no matter which server you play from.
• The /shop shows the tax and your total before you buy, and the purchase message lists the tax paid.
• Use your Rename Card with /use.
• 💬 The bot can now message you directly - keep your DMs open so you don't miss it.

`/violationstatus` - Your Violator Bar (punished reports) and what it does
`/energyleft` - Your energy while restricted (and what every mode costs)

• Rank movement now also shows for Rank 1, so you can see how many positions you climbed to reach the top.
• Removed the software version text from the bot's embeds.

• **Player Community Violation Punishment Order (PCVPO)** - every punished report (Rank Deduction +19%, Points Deduction +23%, Temporary Ban +25%) fills your **Violator Bar**. At 100% you get an **energy limiter**: 30 energy, every mode costs energy and you get +3 every 2 hours. The bar resets every 75 days, and 3 and a half weeks with no punished reports brings back unlimited matches. Your Credit Score still works while restricted.
• Check your bar with `/violationstatus` and your energy with `/energyleft`.

• Who's the Spy: the Spy is now picked much more randomly - the same player can no longer be the Spy two rounds in a row, and players who haven't been the Spy yet are more likely to get it.
• Who's the Spy: the Spy now gets the invisible word 95% of the time, so every round is more exciting.
• Who's the Spy: **See my word** now shows your Role and your Word in a clearer message, and word pairs no longer repeat in the same room until all of them were used.
• Matches needed together before you can send an affinity request lowered from 50 to 10.

• Reworked `/profile`: custom title, @username and ID, then Leaderboard, Level, Rank, Highest Rank, Truth Rate, Win Rate, Badges, Country, Rank Title and your Last Match. The Badges, Affinities and Points buttons are still there.
• Reworked `/affinity`: Partner, Sis, Bro, Besties and Support each have their own section with the slots used, every player's Familiarity Level and the open slots.
• Round results of Truth or Lie and Cup Game reworked: statement and answer (or the cups), who took the round, both scores, points earned, Round Total, Performance Rating and a live countdown to the next round.

• Data saving is faster and the save file is smaller, so there are fewer lag spikes.
• Less memory use: a smaller message cache and a regular cleanup of leftover data.
• Less CPU use: smarter memory cleaning and fewer background checks.

`/serverhealth` - [Admin] Software info and health of the bot
• 💽 Software TCRGDC-6692 V.902 installed - performance tuning, lighter RAM/CPU use and refreshed embeds
• ⚙️ Bot optimization
• 🕵️ **Who's the Spy** (`/whosthespy`) - a party game for 4-12 players: everyone describes a secret word, the Spy has a different word (or none) - vote to catch them!
• Reworked the round conclusion embed of Truth or Lie and Cup Game: it now shows the statement and answer (or the cups), who took the round, both scores and a live countdown to the next round.

• Extra and Extreme: the time to give a statement, hide a cup and lock in an answer is now 90 seconds.
• Extra and Extreme: players who miss a statement, a hide or a lock-in still receive their Ranked Points and Performance Rating. Missing 8 rounds in a row forfeits the match.

• Reworked the game conclusion embed in all modes: it now shows the game mode, when it was played, each player's result, stars and new rank, and a thread closing countdown. Performance Rating and Scores added are shown in `/myperformance` only.
• Reworked the matchmaking embed of the cross-server modes (including Extra and Extreme): it now shows the mode, your rank, a live search timer, the estimated wait time and a short tip.
• Rank and Points positions on `/profile` and on every leaderboard now show how far you climbed (+) or dropped (-) today, counted per match.
